resources.string: Explore AI-based learning platforms tailored for keen learners. A2lytics private Limited is an emerging software development and training company specializing in modern technologies.
Tap the button to embark on your path to AI mastery.

A2lytics Private Limited is a growing software company focused on software development and training.

We develop software in domains like enterprise solutions, web and mobile applications, data analytics, and digital marketing.

We provide training in data science, deep learning, full-stack development, cloud computing, DevOps, and more.

We also offer internships for Diploma, Engineering, BCA, and MCA students, allowing them to work on live projects.
The \"A2\" app provides three user interfaces to interact with the AI model for task completion:
1. Basic Mode: Users enter their query text in the “PROMPT” field and click the “SUBMIT” button. The AI model’s response will be displayed in the “RESPONSE” field.
2. Advanced Mode: Users can choose a format—either “TEXT” or “VOICE”—to input their query and receive a response. Then, they simply click “SUBMIT.”
3. Pro Mode: Users upload a “PDF” file to ask questions based on its content.
For more assistance, please reach out via the provided WhatsApp contact on the top right corner.
